subject: Bench SDK S0: consolidated design doc (docs/bench-sdk-design.md)
description: Persist the consolidated Zonoid Bench SDK design as docs/bench-sdk-design.md (doc-only; the USER reviews this before implementation proceeds — no auto-judge). Capture: motivation (duplication across swe-bench-cl/agent-memory/FeatureBench + divergent ON-arm definitions); scope in/out; runtime (Python stdlib-only, embeddable py312embed full path, Node to spawn daemon); module surface (client/judge/workspace/daemon/warm/arms/report); the CANONICAL ON-arm wiring = REUSE FeatureBench's ClaudeCodeAgent pattern (register note → /search → /task/suggest [suggest_links, ceScore] → wire /overlay/edge → verified DAG → AGENTS.md preload + live /search?task_key= during session); pluggable executor (agent-in-container vs retrieve-and-answer); embedded daemon (ORCH_PORT + CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA + /health, see daemon.js:39/42/332); pre-learnt KB snapshot (inject batches via warm_start.js/onboard-learn.js --inject, OR static AGENTS.md export; keyed by repo@base_commit per pilot-manifest.json); migration plan for the 3 benches. Cite the reuse sources: bench/swe-bench-cl/{zonoid_memory.py,warm_start.js}, bench/agent-memory/{zonoid_lifecycle.py,probe_runner.py}, .venv-fb/Lib/site-packages/featurebench/infer/agents/claude_code.py. Commit on the attempt branch.
